references.disposition: The unique least convex superset C of U, meaning U⊆C and C⊆D for every convex D with U⊆D, is this formulation's characterization of conv(U), not an additional prerequisite. Convexity and inclusion are already linked; leastness, rather than mere inclusion-minimality, is the quantified defining criterion.
